name: price_impact_reversion_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, institutional block executions and algorithmic basket orders occasionally concentrate their fills into single 5-second windows, creating 8-20 spot point directional bars with 2.5-4x the 5-minute average volume. These concentrated sweeps push NIFTY away from session VWAP — the VWAP deviation confirms the bar is an overshoot rather than the start of a sustained directional move. VWAP-benchmarked institutional algorithms, market makers delta-hedging option positions, and statistical-arbitrage programs respond immediately by trading against the overshoot, causing a 40-60% partial reversion within 30-90 seconds as the swept resting orders are replenished.
core_signal_oneliner: Single 5s bar with 2.5x volume spike and 15+ bps price impact that overshoots session VWAP by 12+ bps, triggering mean-reversion entry
